procedure: Built firmware revision c47b655 with local ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Flashed the firmware to the attached ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 on /dev/cu.usbmodem101.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem101 idf-smoke-capabilities from NostrSeal/esp32.
Verified static fixture requests, dynamic request-id variants, invalid metadata requests, and 20 serial-wrapped invalid signing-request vectors loaded from NostrSeal/specs revision 95c84dc.
Verified that parameterless methods reject params: request-get-capabilities-params and request-get-public-key-params returned unsupported_request instead of capability or public-key responses.
expected_result: The device returns valid responses for capability and development public-key requests without params, refuses sign_event with signing_disabled, and rejects invalid metadata plus every shared invalid signing-request vector with deterministic unsupported_request error frames.
observed_result: The device returned 28 protocol frames: six valid static/dynamic response frames and 22 unsupported_request error frames. The error frames covered two invalid metadata vectors and 20 serial-wrapped invalid signing-request vectors, including parameterless-method params misuse. No capability response, public-key response, parser exception, malformed_frame response, or real signing output was observed for invalid requests.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no trusted display, GPIO, camera, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
get_public_key uses the deterministic development fixture key, not production key custody.

sign_event is expected to remain disabled until the parser limits, trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
